title: PRISM — Post Production Management System
overview: PRISM is a comprehensive studio management platform designed for post-production houses handling film, TV serial, web series, and advertisement editing workflows. It brings end-to-end control over studio resources, bookings, billing, and conflict resolution into one unified system.
problem: Post-production studios struggle with manual scheduling that causes frequent double-bookings, no real-time visibility into room and editor availability across locations, error-prone invoice generation, and the operational chaos of managing multiple studio branches independently without centralized control.
solution: PRISM digitizes and centralizes every layer of studio operations — from booking calendars with automated conflict detection to role-based access, multi-company support, and automated chalan and invoice generation — giving studio managers and editors a single source of truth for every resource, booking, and billing event.
howItWorks: Resource Setup: Configure rooms, editors, equipment, and leave schedules across all studio locations in a centralized master.
Smart Booking Calendar: Create and manage bookings with real-time conflict detection, preventing double-bookings before they happen.
Editor & Room Availability: Live dashboard showing resource status across all locations, enabling instant booking decisions.
Automated Billing: Generate accurate chalans and invoices based on booking data, eliminating manual calculation errors.
Leave Management: Integrated leave tracking with booking impact analysis to flag scheduling risks proactively.
Multi-Company Control: Franchise-ready architecture with centralized oversight and role-based permissions per branch.
features: Booking Calendar: Real-time conflict detection and centralized scheduling for rooms and editors.
Resource Master: Manage customer, project, room, and editor records across all locations.
Conflict Report: Automated detection and reporting of scheduling conflicts before they disrupt operations.
Chalan & Invoice Generation: Accurate, automated billing tied directly to booking records.
Leave Management: Track editor leave with direct impact analysis on active bookings.
Multi-Company Support: Centralized control with location-level isolation and role-based access.
User Rights Management: Granular permissions for different staff levels and operational roles.
useCases: Film & TV Post-Production Houses: Schedule editing bays, dubbing studios, and colorist rooms without conflicts.
Multi-Location Studio Chains: Operate franchise branches with shared visibility and centralized billing.
Advertisement Production: Manage tight turnaround bookings with automated conflict alerts.
Web Series Studios: Handle long-running project timelines with editor leave tracking and billing.
Independent Editing Studios: Replace spreadsheets and manual logs with a professional operations layer.
whyBetter: 100% Conflict Elimination: Automated conflict detection removes the root cause of double-booking disruptions.
80% Faster Billing: Automated chalan and invoice generation replaces hours of manual invoicing work.
35% Better Utilization: Unified availability visibility across locations fills booking gaps that manual systems miss.
Built for Post-Production: Purpose-built for studio workflows, not adapted from generic booking or ERP tools.
summary: PRISM transforms fragmented studio operations into a conflict-free, automated management system — giving post-production businesses the operational clarity and billing accuracy they need to scale.
